primitives.name: Kickoff return play
primitives.verbatim_quote: RUNNING THE TEAM 103 teach the center to keep a narrow watch on the kicker and the position of the ball on the tee, since very often one or the other will telegraph this play in plenty of time to stop it.
primitives.assumptions: Center must monitor kicker and ball placement for early telegraphing cues.
primitives.breakdown_regime: No specific breakdown noted; relies on observational accuracy.

layer2.mapping: Bayesian updating of conditional probabilities based on observable player behavior.
layer2.telemetry: Tracking center's reaction time and accuracy in identifying telegraphing patterns.

primitives.name: Short kickoff gain
primitives.verbatim_quote: In 1907 this short kick-off worked against the best team in the country for a gain of thirty or forty yards, putting the kicking side in a position to score in the first ten seconds of the second half.
primitives.assumptions: Effective execution yields immediate spatial advantage.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Risk of fumble or interception negates the gain.

layer2.mapping: Conformal prediction intervals for potential yardage gains under varying defensive readiness.
layer2.telemetry: Measuring actual yardage achieved versus expected yardage based on defensive positioning.

primitives.name: Risk assessment kickoff
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is a play used far less frequently than it deserves and a hard one to stop, although now that the field has been shortened and the kick-off is from defensive territory, it has more risk than it once involved for the side which plays it.
primitives.assumptions: Reduced field length increases defensive vulnerability after successful play.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Increased probability of counter-attack following the initial gain.

layer2.mapping: Derivative analysis of risk-reward tradeoffs in spatial game theory.
layer2.telemetry: Quantifying the ratio of successful plays to subsequent defensive vulnerabilities.

primitives.name: Post-kickoff offensive setup
primitives.verbatim_quote: We assume that the kick-off has been caught and carried back to the thirty-yard line, which is frequent enough to be considered commonplace.
primitives.assumptions: Standard post-return field position for initiating offensive strategy.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Initial field position determines viable offensive playbook options.

layer2.mapping: State-transition matrix defining common starting positions for offensive drive modeling.
layer2.telemetry: Analyzing the distribution of starting field positions across multiple games.
